lyrics.ja: 吸い込まれそうな空の下
lyrics.en: Under a sky that seems to swallow me up
lyrics.zh: 在彷彿要將人吸入的天空下

lyrics.en: So that my tears wouldn't overflow
lyrics.zh: 為了不讓眼淚奪眶而出

lyrics.en: I looked up and hid it

lyrics.ja: 君は気付いていたのかな
lyrics.romaji: Kimi ha Kizuite Ita no Kana
lyrics.en: I wonder if you had noticed

lyrics.ja: 背中越しに聞こえてる
lyrics.en: Even the sound of someone's laughter
That I hear over my shoulder
Echoes painfully

lyrics.romaji: Konna ni Mune no Oku ga
lyrics.en: Why does my heart
Hurt so much?
Blown by the spring wind
Petals dancing in the air

lyrics.ja: さよならと言えずに眺めてた
lyrics.en: I gazed at them, unable to say goodbye
lyrics.zh: 無法說出再見，只能凝望

lyrics.ja: もしも君といつかまた会えた時には
lyrics.romaji: Moshimo Kimi to Itsuka Mata Aeta Toki ni ha
lyrics.en: If someday we can meet again
lyrics.zh: 如果有一天還能與你相見

lyrics.ja: 大好きだよと伝えるから
lyrics.romaji: Daisuki Da yo to Tsutaeru kara
lyrics.en: I'll tell you that I love you
lyrics.zh: 我一定會告訴你「我最喜歡你」

lyrics.ja: 何もかもわかってたんだね
lyrics.romaji: Nani mo Kamo Wakatteta n Da ne
lyrics.en: You understood everything, didn't you?

lyrics.ja: 頷いた君の笑顔　忘れない
lyrics.en: I won't forget your smiling face as you nodded
lyrics.zh: 我不會忘記你點頭時的笑容

lyrics.ja: ねぇ今もまだ覚えてる？
lyrics.en: Hey, do you still remember?

lyrics.ja: はじめて交わした言葉
lyrics.en: The first words we exchanged
lyrics.zh: 我們第一次交談的話語

lyrics.en: Until we called each other by name

lyrics.ja: 時間はかからなかったね
lyrics.en: It didn't take long, did it?

lyrics.romaji: Nani wo Suru ni mo Futari de
lyrics.en: Whatever we did, we did together
lyrics.zh: 無論做什麼都是兩個人一起

lyrics.en: We saw the same scenery
Even the sky after school
Even silly doodles
They were all shining
The memories of those days
That connect us

lyrics.romaji: Ikusen no Hoshi no Hikari ni Nari
lyrics.en: Become the light of thousands of stars
lyrics.zh: 化作了千萬星辰的光芒

lyrics.en: Even if we're far apart
Even decades from now

lyrics.ja: 透明な未来を照らすだろう
lyrics.romaji: Toumei na Mirai wo Terasu Darou
lyrics.en: They will illuminate a transparent future
lyrics.zh: 也會照亮透明的未來吧

lyrics.ja: なんとなく目を閉じたまま
lyrics.en: With my eyes closed, almost on a whim

lyrics.ja: 「大丈夫」そう言い聞かせて　歩き出す
lyrics.en: Telling myself "It's okay," I start walking
lyrics.zh: 對自己說「沒關係」，邁出步伐

lyrics.romaji: Nando mo Namae wo Yobu yo
lyrics.en: I'll call your name again and again
lyrics.zh: 我會一次次呼喚你的名字

lyrics.ja: この桜並木の下で　聞こえる？
lyrics.romaji: Kono Sakura Namiki no Shita de Kikoeru?
lyrics.en: Under this row of cherry trees—can you hear me?
lyrics.zh: 在這櫻花樹下，你聽得到嗎？

lyrics.en: Blown by the spring wind
Petals dancing in the air

lyrics.ja: さよならと言えずに眺めてた
lyrics.en: I gazed at them, unable to say goodbye
lyrics.zh: 無法說出再見，只能凝望

lyrics.en: If someday we can meet again
lyrics.zh: 如果有一天還能與你相見

lyrics.romaji: Daisuki Da yo to Tsutaeru kara

lyrics.zh: 我一定會告訴你「我最喜歡你」
